subject: 2025년 9월 고1 모의고사
title: Moral Goodness
fullPassage: A person who always tries to prevent harm but never does, is not generally thought of as morally good. A morally good person is one who does morally bad actions significantly less often than most and does morally good ones significantly more often than most. In judging a person not only her actions but also her intentions and motives are relevant. A morally good person must intend to do morally good actions and intend to avoid morally bad ones. A person who unintentionally prevents harm to others and does not harm them simply because things do not turn out as she intends is not morally good. Although this kind of situation generally occurs only in slapstick movies, it is worth mentioning to avoid the false impression that it is the actual consequences of a person's actions that count toward her being judged morally good or bad. But actual consequences are important. Of such a person, it may be said that she means well; but, contrary to Kant, some results are necessary before she is regarded as morally good.
